results: Unique pure immediate SPE for the stated contractive class, characterized by p1=1-D2(p2), p2=1-D1(p1).
Unique behavioral immediate SPE for 0<delta_i<1, with p1=(1-delta2)/(1-delta1*delta2), p2=(1-delta1)/(1-delta1*delta2); every off-path threshold and tie response is specified.
Discounted patience comparative statics and short-period limit r2/(r1+r2), proved as a limit of discrete equilibria.

Positive unequal additive costs yield unique immediate behavioral SPE: the lower-cost proposer receives one; the other proposer receives min(lower cost,1). Both costs at least one yield proposer share one for both roles.

Equal additive costs c in (0,1) yield a stationary immediate family p1 in [c,1], p2=1-p1+c. At c=1/10 a full nonstationary pure SPE agrees at date one with allocation (4/5,1/5) and utilities (7/10,1/10).
Explicit boundary SPE permit any specified finite delay with one patient player receiving the entire pie; with both patient, any fixed division can follow any finite delay.
